one_liner: Tyrese Haliburton records 11 assists per 36 minutes on 47.4 percent shooting -- volume creation without the usual efficiency penalty.
three_things: 11 assists per 36 while still converting 47.4 percent of his own shots.
37.4 percent from three and 85.3 percent from the line.
The sample is two seasons and 140 games, thinner than most of this set.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 2-season sample (seasons_played: 2), so the floor is thinner than for the three-season players in this set. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
